introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
Upon arriving at Planarcadia, Himeko proposes holding a celebration bursting with local flavor. Become a game streamer representing the Astral Express and broadcast your trailblazing expedition to the entire cosmos.

◆ Event Objectives ◆
● In this event, Trailblazers will act as a game streamer, broadcasting their trailblazing expedition to the entire cosmos.
● While clearing stages, Trailblazers can obtain stronger equipment to boost their team's combat power. You can also earn Diamonds and Gold Coins to draw for and enhance characters.
● By setting up appropriate team lineups and using enhancement resources, Trailblazers can increase combat power and clear more stages. The more stages cleared, the higher the efficiency of idle resource production.
● At special stage nodes, Trailblazers can also encounter important team leader characters, which will greatly alter the combat gameplay.

◆ Combat Info ◆
● In the battles for this event, characters are divided into Combat and Support roles with various unique Traits. They will automatically attack enemies.
● Trailblazers can control Combat characters to actively use abilities. When the shared Energy is full, you can also have Combat characters jointly unleash Joint Ultimates. You may also enable Auto-Battle mode to let characters freely use their abilities and Joint Ultimate.
● The Team Leader is a special Combat character that can greatly alter combat effects. The more characters of the same Trait as the Team Leader, the stronger the Leader's effects.
● Support characters will automatically use abilities once their cooldowns end. Support characters will also appear together when a Joint Ultimate is unleashed.

◆ Livestream Info ◆
● During the livestream, viewers will send gifts. These aren't just a boost for the Trailblazer's growth. They can also trigger special effects...
● Some viewers might make specific requests. Choose whether or not to respond to them!
● Aside from gaming, the livestream also features guest collaborations. Why not try connecting with an old friend after finishing every chapter?

◆ Event Hints ◆
● Level up character slots and form specific schools to greatly increase combat power and overcome difficult challenges.
● Whether the Trailblazer is online or not, the team can continuously earn Equipment, Gold Coins, and Diamonds based on the current stage progress.
● When resources are scarce and combat power is insufficient, why not let the team go AFK to idly gather resources and fight another day?

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● Progress through your trailblazing expedition in the game and complete various Gameplay Goals under Limited-Time Rewards to obtain rewards.
